Ending balances and changes imply Streets (168,353) and Sales Tax 110,838 (matching budget schedules pp10-11). Total 160,991 used.

notes: Modified cash basis (governmental), accrual (business-type). Governmental beginning cash = beginning fund balance as restated 160,991 (p5); ending 225,366 is the fund balance (net of 777,321 due to other funds against 1,002,687 of cash assets). Business-type: Electric, Sewer, Water funds, measure net position, from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7); receipts = operating revenue + gain on sale; disbursements = operating expenses (incl. depreciation) + interest expense. Business-type reported totals computed as no single total printed. Business-type spending by cost type (attempt 2: Energy Purchases -> Purchased Power/Cost of Sales, function utilities). Balance sheet uses government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), kept because its governmental column includes interfund amounts (internal balances -777,321) so its totals differ from the governmental funds balance sheet (total assets 1,002,687). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p9) used; the General Fund combining schedule (pp12-13, 8 sub-fund columns: General, Fire, Police, Parks, Golf, Swimming Pool, Library, Keno) is the same totals by sub-fund and was not recorded, to avoid double counting. No budget schedules for utility funds in the trimmed PDF. Proprietary cash flow statement (p8) not recorded since basis is cash. Transfers cross-check: Streets out 19,605 matches Sales Tax in 19,605; governmental net transfers +411,013 match business-type -411,013. Read pages 1-13 of 13
